block-guide:
CORE/BLOCK (a global block / synced pattern placement) Draws a saved synced pattern (wp_block) by its id. The words live in the pattern, not here: read and change them with get-synced-pattern / save-synced-pattern; every placement then changes.
MARKUP <!-- wp:block {"ref":123} /--> As an entry: {"name":"core/block","attributes":{"ref":123}}. Comment only, no HTML. ref is a number (a quoted "123" is stored as 123). Take it from list-synced-patterns.
WHAT IS REFUSED - A ref to nothing, to a pattern in the trash, or to an unsynced pattern. - A language version's id: place the original; each language is shown its own version. - A header or footer pattern in a page (save-content): those go into a template (save-template). Section patterns go anywhere. - A pattern that places itself.
HOW IT DRAWS No wrapper element of its own: the pattern's blocks are output as they are. className, spacing or colors on core/block draw nothing; put the wrapper group, its width and colors inside the pattern. A pattern that is not published, or has a password, draws nothing (no error on the page). In a Fabrement template the header and footer are core/block placements; the theme's own header and footer are not drawn there.
PITFALLS - To change one page's copy only, do not edit the pattern: it changes every page placing it. Write ordinary blocks in that page instead. - Before a change, read usedBy from get-synced-pattern: where the pattern is placed.
CHECK Open two pages that place the pattern: both show the change.
